crossRefs.note: Then I wouldn’t be disappointed, when I consider all of your commandments.
How I love your law! It is my meditation all day.
I have taken your testimonies as a heritage forever, for they are the joy of my heart.
Consider how I love your precepts. Revive me, Yahweh, according to your loving kindness.

Even as the Father has loved me, I also have loved you. Remain in my love.

I delight to do your will, my God. Yes, your law is within my heart.”

parallels.note: Take good heed therefore to yourselves, that you love Yahweh your God.

translations.web: My soul has observed your testimonies. I love them exceedingly.
translations.bsb: I obey Your testimonies and love them greatly.
translations.kjv: My soul hath kept thy testimonies; and I love them exceedingly.
translations.asv: My soul hath observed thy testimonies; And I love them exceedingly.
